recipe.visualDefinition: A complex surrealist composition featuring a central circular portal set against a mottled red marble background. Inside the circle, a large-scale portrait of a man with a prominent afro and beard anchors the foreground, while a group of figures stands in a desolate, fiery landscape behind him. Above them, a purple-skinned demonic figure is being attacked by small, white-robed angelic beings against a dark sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground portrait scale vs. background group scale
Circular frame vs. square outer boundary
Warm fiery landscape vs. cool dark celestial sky
Organic marble texture vs. sharp illustrative detail
coreInvariants: Circular vignette framing the main scene
High-contrast lighting from a low horizon source
Surreal juxtaposition of mythological and contemporary figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a large portrait in the lower left quadrant of the circle; secondary group of figures stands in the middle ground right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large afro of the foreground figure provides a dark, textured anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large portrait, move right to the standing group, then upward to the demonic figure and the swirling angels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark upper portion of the circle provides breathing room for the complex action below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep reds and browns in the marble border and fiery landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark blacks and deep blues in the night sky and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the angelic figures and highlights on the afro; purple for the central demon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the fire and marble; low value in the sky creating a dramatic 'chiaroscuro' effect.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the marble border at the top

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum clarity against the busy background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical Roman proportions and sharp serifs.
Captures the high-contrast old-style serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist airbrushed painting inside a circular frame. The frame is surrounded by a red marble texture. Inside the circle, a man with a large afro is in the foreground. Behind him is a group of people in 70s attire standing in a burning, ruined city. In the dark sky above, a purple demon is being attacked by small white angels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in a white, all-caps, wide-spaced classical serif font centered at the top of the image, overlapping the marble texture.

verificationChecks: Is the marble texture visible outside the circle?
Is the foreground portrait significantly larger than the background figures?
Is the text in a sharp, white serif font?
Does the color palette transition from fiery orange to dark blue?

adjustableVariables: Level of detail in the burning city
Skin tone of the demonic figure
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the circle is perfectly centered.
Check that the text is legible against the marble background.
Verify the surreal scale relationships are maintained.
Confirm the texture of the afro is rendered with high detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Narrative + Circular Vignette + Marble Border + Classical Serif Typography
